beats.en: Every map has three important components: distance, direction and symbols. Distance is shown by the scale. A huge place fits on a small sheet because each centimetre on the map stands for a fixed distance on the ground.

textbookBox.concept: Mapping the Earth is harder because our planet is not flat. It is nearly a sphere. We say nearly because it is slightly flattened at the poles, but in practice we treat it as a sphere.

beats.en: Mapping the Earth is harder because our planet is not flat. It is nearly a sphere. We say nearly because it is slightly flattened at the poles, but in practice we treat it as a sphere.
